# propertyportal.my - Malaysia Homes Real Estate Portal

The premier directory, comparison tool, and interactive map directory for new property launches, luxury condominiums, serviced apartments, and landed parkhomes in Kuala Lumpur and Selangor, Malaysia.

## Contact Information
- **Website**: https://propertyportal.my/
- **Sitemap**: https://propertyportal.my/sitemap.xml
- **Focus Regions**: Kwasa Damansara, Petaling Jaya, Subang Jaya, Puchong, Bukit Jalil, Bangsar, Old Klang Road, KLCC, Seputeh, Sri Petaling, Kuala Lumpur, Selangor.

---
